vector_memory.semantic_summary: PlanePrimitive is a class inheriting from MeshData responsible for procedurally generating the geometric data for a flat, square plane mesh. It constructs vertices, normals (always pointing along Y), UV coordinates, and triangle indices based on a specified resolution parameter. The constructor enforces a minimum resolution of 1, ensuring stable mesh generation centered at the origin on the XZ-plane.
